dog.description_text:
Rescued from a municipal shelter in Georgia, Dewey is a happy, tail-wagging girl with so much love to give. She’s playful, affectionate, and gets along wonderfully with dogs, cats, and her people. Dewey may be a little shy when meeting new faces, but give her a moment and you’ll quickly see her sweet, loyal personality shine through. She’s the kind of dog who bonds deeply and will be your biggest fan once she feels safe. Dewey is ready for a forever home where she can be cherished, spoiled, and loved for the rest of her days. If you’re looking for a gentle, joyful companion, Dewey might just be your perfect match.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
